Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a University of Washington center for human rights.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a University of Washington centerfor human rights; adding a new section to chapter 28B.20 RCW; andmaking an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A University of Washington center for human rights is created. Themission of the center is to expand opportunities for Washingtonresidents to receive a worldclass education in human rights, generateresearch data and expert knowledge to enhance public and privatepolicymaking, and become an academic center for human rights teachingand research in the nation. Key substantive issues for the centerinclude: The rights of all persons to security against violence; therights of immigrants, native Americans, and ethnic or religiousminorities; human rights and the environment; health as a human right;human rights and trade; the human rights of working people; and women'srights as human rights.

The sum of one million dollars, or as muchthereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal year endingJune 30, 2010, from the general fund to the higher educationcoordinating board for the purposes of this act.
